description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDisplayField' that represents a display field entity used within a reporting or display module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties related to field attributes such as name, label, width, sorting, encryption, and grouping, along with getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: AbstractDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract class representing a display field entity with properties such as name, label, width, sorting, encryption, and grouping, used within the reporting module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: getReportGroup
methods.description: Returns the ReportGroup associated with this display field.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Sets the ReportGroup associated with this display field.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the display field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the display field.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the display field.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label of the display field.

methods.name: getFieldAlias
methods.description: Retrieves the field alias, if any.

methods.name: isSortable
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is sortable.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the width of the display field.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the display field.

methods.name: isExportable
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is exportable.

methods.name: isValueList
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is a value list.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the associated display field group.

methods.name: isEncrypted
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is encrypted.

methods.name: isMeta
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is meta.
